bucket_reason: Medium confidence after deepen round 2 (recommend: more_observation). Proof work at medium confidence needs Dennis's call.
question: Spend one short targeted stage on rules for the shift-on-wall (0111000) states before proof.md, start proof.md now with the wrap coincidence as an open lemma, or park?

options.label: One targeted stage (at most 2 h): rules for the shift-on-wall states
options.consequence: Run arr.py for 2-4 arrivals on 0111000 plus context, across wall types and wire lengths. If every case returns to L_gap, a closed superset L_gap+ is a purely structural invariant and proof.md can start: nursery period, interior-wire lemma, and closure under the unit rewrite. If some case does not return, only the timing argument is left, and Dennis gets a sharper call on whether that counts as pseudo-random arithmetic.

options.label: Start proof.md now, coincidence left open
options.consequence: proof.md would be conditional on one lemma, as #13's is, and a skeptic review would mark that gap fatal. Rules for the escape states would still be needed before Rocq.

options.label: Park
options.consequence: Gives up a machine whose whole run is one exact rewrite (79,527/79,527 arrivals) with one narrow open point.

rationale: Everything right of the nursery is one cell language, L_gap, with 0 violations at 2,251 left records to 2e10. One B arrival is an exact unit carry rewrite, matching the machine on 79,527 of 79,527 random arrivals. The run can leave L_gap only through one counter-wrap coincidence, a shift landing on a wall. Forcing that coincidence 400 times gave 154 exits and 0 halts in 3,000 arrivals, so the exit states look harmless, but they have no rules yet. The next experiment is small and decisive. A few arrivals on 0111000, run in isolation, are exact, because the right end only receives B and returns C. The result decides between a structural invariant (proof can start) and a timing argument (back to Dennis). Starting proof.md first would only produce a conditional proof with a known fatal gap.

evidence.text: L_gap (runs of 1-3; gaps >= 3 and 0 or 3 mod 4; 3-runs only after a gap of 3 mod 4): 0 violations at 2,251 left records from 2e5 to 2e10 (realcheck.py).
The unit carry rewrite equals the machine on 79,527/79,527 random arrivals (checkinc.py). 13 junction rewrites plus 6 sweep macros reproduce the blank run exactly to 20,000,003,117 steps.

The only exit from L_gap: a W with a 1-block wire finishes a round while k >= 2 digits wrap from 2^k-3 to 0, and the next unit is a wall. Forced 400 times: 154 exits, 0 halts in 3,000 arrivals (coinc.py). A looser language with 4-runs halts once in 3,000 (explore5.py), so the exit states need exact rules.
Blank run: at most 1 zone wall at a time. 11 of 2,251 left records have one, none after 2e9, and 6 of those 11 sit on digits only (zonewalls2.py).
